source_quality_issues: Companion link PDF internal title is gen2 preliminary LED Product Information, not a detailed ASIC datasheet.
Gen2 2024 blog minimum 85 MNits versus 2025 PI 75-110 MNits remains unresolved across bin/version/test conditions.
Gen2 webpage ENES and PI EMES full product-type spelling differ for ordering code Q65113A6747.
Gen1 PI pages have different dates; column orientation follows p.3 General Description.
Gen2 p.2 mentions 19200 pixels, but p.3 ordering only explicitly identifies the 25600 option.
independent_implementation_boundary: Own documented serial/frame packet; no supplier register or protocol compatibility claim.
Current/PWM/blank/fault functional research using public PDK and independent implementation.
No commercial RTL, transistor schematic or layout reconstruction.
No AEC, ASIL, tape-out or optical-measurement evidence upgrade through a neighboring stage.
